coming.name: Anantara Siam Bangkok
coming.note: Relaunching in 2026 after a two phase transformation of its 338 rooms and suites, with six new Garden Suites with private plunge pools and a Jim Thompson Suite; dining stayed open throughout.
coming.tagline: Anantara's Bangkok hotel, transformed in two phases

coming.name: The Chedi Aquarius Koh Chang
coming.note: A 200 key GHM resort on Koh Chang, Thailand's third largest island, less than an hour by ferry from the mainland, set to open in 2026.
coming.tagline: GHM's resort on Koh Chang, over the Gulf of Thailand

coming.name: Kahavadi Chiang Rai
coming.note: Opened 1 July 2026 on the banks of the Mae Kok River in Chiang Rai, with 167 rooms and suites.
coming.tagline: A Curio Collection hotel on the Mae Kok River in Chiang Rai

coming.name: Singita Elela
coming.note: Singita's first Botswana lodge: eight raised camps on a 170,000-hectare private concession in the western Okavango, on the former Abu Camp site. Opens 11 December 2026.
coming.tagline: Singita's first Botswana lodge: eight raised camps in the western Okavango Delta
coming.airport: Maun Airport (MUB), then Elela's own airstrip

coming.name: InterContinental Bora Bora Resort & Thalasso Spa
coming.note: Closed since 1 June 2026 for a full transformation; reopening in late 2027 as Regent Bora Bora, the Regent brand's debut in French Polynesia, with 84 overwater villas on a private motu facing Mount Otemanu.
coming.tagline: Overwater villas on Motu Piti Aau, and French Polynesia's only Thalasso spa.

coming.name: andBeyond Xaranna Okavango Delta Lodge
coming.note: andBeyond is rebuilding Xaranna Okavango Delta Camp as andBeyond Xaranna Okavango Delta Lodge, reopening August 2027.

coming.name: Six Senses Uluwatu Bali
coming.note: Being reimagined: closed since 1 February 2026 for a transformation of its cliffside resort, with no reopening date announced yet.
coming.tagline: Clifftop wellness, sacred Balinese culture, and endless Indian Ocean horizons.
